name: East Ridge via Aasgard Pass Route
descent_text: It is a common and dangerous mistake for fatigued parties to veer too far climber's-right (west) on the Aasgard Pass descent into steep, cliffed-out terrain — stay on the cairned line trending climber's-left (east). A slide on the steep upper pass could carry a climber into boulders below; icy conditions here have contributed to serious falls and fatalities.
